You cross out the line saying the team can cover as needed.

You add the missing approval contact and thank her for catching it. You don't explain that you would have known the answer. The whole point is to make the answer available without making your availability permanent.

loop_evidence.closes_evidence: It turns out he wants toasted cheese and tomato on the bread you have. You repeat the choice and return to the kitchen. You've spent the day coordinating an approved dinner, and the person who approved it has changed his mind after you've put it in front of him.
loop_evidence.closes_evidence: Oliver listens better the next morning than he would have during dinner. He says the meal was good, but he was in the mood for something familiar. You discuss what is reasonable rather than agreeing that every preference should permanently occupy the stores.
